subject: Tiered compensation proposal for TekScale latency incident
messages:
From: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@tekscale.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Severe latency impacting nightly batch jobs - compensation request

Hi Karthik,

We experienced sustained high tail latency across hosted inference from 02:00–08:00 UTC on 2027-04-18 that caused three of our nightly batch jobs to miss SLAs. Our engineering team traced it to a routing/backpressure issue that appears to be on the Redwood side (ticket INF-3914). This affected customer-facing reports and one downstream ETL pipeline — estimated business impact ~ $18k for that window.

Can you share what remediation / compensation Redwood can offer? We would like a formal compensation proposal (credits and any trial extensions or priority support) so we can close this with Procurement. We rely on the hosted API and this outage reduces confidence for our upcoming production rollout.

Attached: initial incident notes from our SREs.

Thanks,
Alyssa Nguyen
Sr. Tech Ops Manager, TekScale
[attachment: tekscale_incident_summary.pdf (pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Severe latency impacting nightly batch jobs - compensation request

Folks — forwarding TekScale's ask. This is a growing strategic account (TS-PRD-4821). SRE confirmed a partial routing regression during that window; our side is taking ownership. They want a formal compensation proposal for Procurement.

Quick asks:
- Monica: proposed compensation package (credits, trial extension, priority hours). Please include implementation offer (Dedicated consult or migration credits).
- Markus: any legal/precedent constraints for credits over $25k and wording for a non-precedent clause?
- Jordan: sales perspective — is there an open renewal or upsell we should consider to offset this? We should be prompt; they want documentation for Procurement.

I attached their summary and our INF ticket. Planning to respond to TekScale within 6 business hours.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
[attachment: INF-3914_log_export.txt (txt)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Severe latency impacting nightly batch jobs - compensation request

Thanks Karthik — drafting a tiered remediation package for Procurement. Proposal below (for internal review):

Tier A (preferred):
- $30,000 service credit applied to monthly usage (one-time credit).
- 2 extra months of free Redwood Optimize (priority quantization/batching review).
- One-day Dedicated migration/optimization workshop (remote) to harden routing and reduce tail latency.

Tier B (mitigation alternative):
- $15,000 service credit.
- 1 month free Optimize.
- 10 hours of priority support (SRE on-call assistance) to tune production config.

Notes:
- I recommend we offer Tier A as the default to preserve the relationship; TekScale is mid-market but growing fast and is evaluating Dedicated next quarter.
- Attaching a short spreadsheet with cost/calculation.

If Markus flags precedent, we can move to Tier B. Jordan, if this is tied to the renewal, we should offer the workshop as a conditional add-on to accelerate conversion.

Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
[attachment: proposed_comp_table.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Severe latency impacting nightly batch jobs - compensation request

Appreciate the fast turnaround. A few legal/finance constraints:

- Single-event credits > $25k require Director approval from Finance; recommend capping at $25k for standard approval.
- Include explicit non-precedent language: "This credit is a one-time remedy for the incident described and does not create any future entitlement."
- Any free-month/license concession must be time-boxed and documented against the TS-PRD-4821 account record.

If the account team believes Tier A is necessary for retention/upsell, I can escalate to Finance for the additional $5k, but will need a short justification (renewal status, ARR at risk, and expected uplift).

Markus
VP Finance (acting), Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@tekscale.com>, procurement@tekscale.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-21T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Severe latency impacting nightly batch jobs - compensation request

Alyssa — thank you again for the detailed notes and patience. Redwood has reviewed INF-3914 and the customer impact. Below is our formal remediation offer for the 2027-04-18 latency window: 

Approved offer (final):
- $25,000 one-time service credit applied to TekScale account (TS-PRD-4821).
- 1 month complimentary Redwood Optimize service (priority evaluation and batching recommendations).
- 10 hours of priority support for SRE-assisted tuning.

We are including a one-time workshop to walk through routing improvements; scheduling is flexible and we can dedicate SRE resources to accelerate this before your rollout. This credit is a one-time remedy for the incident described and does not create any future entitlement.

Action items:
- I attached the credit/offer summary and the DocuSign link for a short acceptance form (needed for Procurement records). Please return signed by procurement so we can apply the credit.
- Monica will follow up to schedule the Optimize review and support hours.

Attachments: proposed_comp_table.xlsx, tekscale_incident_summary.pdf
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC1234
INF ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3914

If you need more detail for your Procurement team, let me know and Markus can provide finance confirmation.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
